text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss was detected by the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change dataset (version GFC-2025-v1.13). It mapped about 81.3 ha of loss within the asset, roughly 2.23% of its 3,643.5 ha.

Two other datasets corroborated it but did not detect it:
- **JRC GFC2020 V4:** 98% of the event area was forest in 2020.
- **MGAP 2021 forest map:** 68.1 ha was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and no native forest was affected.

Hansen also recorded another 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha. These were not counted as an event.

This shows tree-cover loss only. It does not show deforestation or land-use change, since Hansen loss includes plantation cutting. It also does not establish the cause, legality, responsibility, or any compliance finding.
